signal: Consolidated Communications selected Alianza's cloud communications platform in June 2026, building on Alianza's base of over 1,000 service providers

email.body1:
Rob, saw Consolidated Communications just picked Alianza to power its next-generation voice services.

Wins like that usually mean more in-market service providers worth a conversation than your team can reach before the momentum cools. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rob, quick follow-up for Alianza.

With a marquee carrier win to build on, most sales leaders can't say how many meetings they actually need to turn that proof into pipeline, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alianza needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rob, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rob, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Onboarding a major carrier is its own kind of busy and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a communications-platform motion? I'll tailor it to Alianza either way.
